purpose: Define outsider as an explicit visible classification for canonical nodes that do not yet belong to any existing Topic, preventing silent unclassified semantics.

topics.name: Outsider
topics.purpose: Define outsider as an explicit visible classification for canonical nodes that do not yet belong to any existing Topic, preventing silent unclassified semantics.

operations.name: Review outsider
outputs: remain outsider | assign existing Topic | create Topic

semantics.rule: A node with zero Topic memberships must be explicitly marked outsider.
semantics.visibility_rule: Outsider state is machine-visible and human-visible.
semantics.reason_rule: Outsider classification records why no current Topic applies.
semantics.review_rule: Outsiders are candidates for assignment to an existing Topic or creation of a new Topic.
semantics.non_error_rule: Outsider may be a valid temporary semantic state, but never an invisible omission.
semantics.lock_rule: Lock eligibility must explicitly account for remaining outsiders.

invariants.rule: Every machine-significant canonical node is classified by explicit Topic membership or explicitly marked outsider; Topics may inherit and compose other Topics.

references.purpose: Outsider is the explicit alternative to Topic membership.

prose.summary: Define outsider as an explicit visible classification for canonical nodes that do not yet belong to any existing Topic, preventing silent unclassified semantics.
notes: Unlocked until reconciled against the assembled 1.4 Topic graph and repository-wide validation.
